name: SpireTalk: Living Ancients
author: peiji
description: Talk to the Ancients and the Merchant. Bring your own API key (OpenRouter / OpenAI / Ollama) or sign in to Yumina; three lines per visit, they remember you across runs, and a good relationship can earn a relic reroll, gold, healing, a potion or a shop discount. Works with or without Ancient Affection.
